svg.title: feel — I didn't come this far just to come this far.
svg.desc: Black and silver procedural elephant drawing with red impulses. The elephant draws itself, idles, strikes its trunk, and reconstructs. TypeShift and Doompedia are the featured projects. Smaller structures show Planora, SystemForge, RPS, MANTA, Anubis, Gems, Commit, and Portfolio. Connecting paths describe shared themes, not software dependencies. The lettering remains visible throughout.
